summary: Phase 32 SEO & Structured Data — full-stack E2E testing. Backend: 18/18 pytest pass (test_seo.py). Admin UI /admin/seo renders all 6 tabs (Per-Page, Structured Data, Global, Redirects, Sitemap & Robots, Health) with full interactivity. Public meta + JSON-LD injection verified on /, /menu, /product/{id}. One bug found: product page canonical URL leaks literal {id} template instead of actual product_id.

ui_bugs.issue: Canonical URL on product detail page is https://seo-test.example.com/product/%7Bid%7D (literal template) instead of the actual product id. Root cause in backend/routes/seo.py:373 — canonical falls back to f"{base_url}{PAGE_PATHS['product']}" which is "/product/{id}". The template placeholder is never substituted with the supplied product_id query param. Menu/category have a similar exposure with {slug} for category page.

action_items: Fix canonical URL templating in /app/backend/routes/seo.py public_page_seo: when page_key == 'product' and product_id is provided, build canonical as f"{base_url}/product/{product_id}"; when page_key == 'category' and category_slug is provided, build canonical as f"{base_url}/menu/{category_slug}". Currently path = PAGE_PATHS.get(page_key) returns the un-substituted template.
Note for main agent: review request mentioned testid 'seo-tab-per-page' but actual testid is 'seo-tab-pages' — documentation drift only; functionality fine.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/seo.py canonical fallback does not substitute route params ({id}, {slug}) — leads to bad SEO canonicals.
Redirect uniqueness check uses from_path only; fine. Status 409 surfaced correctly in admin UI (console shows 409 on duplicate attempt).
_build_structured_data makes N+1 queries per Menu type (one per category). Acceptable for typical menu sizes but could be cached on hot public endpoint.
/api/seo/sitemap.xml includes products + categories (31 URLs on test DB) — correct. Lastmod truncated to YYYY-MM-DD — good.
Admin SEO page title character counters, SERP preview, and OG card preview all update live — good UX.
Note: admin 'Saved' indicator stays even when edits are unsaved (visual only); minor.

All 6 SEO admin tabs use testids: seo-tab-pages (not seo-tab-per-page), seo-tab-structured, seo-tab-global, seo-tab-redirects, seo-tab-sitemap, seo-tab-health. rca_of_the_issue: Canonical bug: In routes/seo.py public_page_seo(), after enriching 'page' with product context, the function computes canonical via `f"{base_url}{path}"` where path = PAGE_PATHS['product'] = '/product/{id}'. The literal string `{id}` is then URL-encoded to %7Bid%7D by the browser. Fix: when page_key is 'product' and product_id provided, use `/product/{product_id}`; same for 'category' + category_slug. Also set meta.canonical_url accordingly so <link rel=canonical> and og:url both reflect the real URL.
